history.contentIn: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) are not just struggling; they are on the brink of extinction, victims of a sinister agenda that manipulates our climate while planes endlessly spray above us. These majestic beings depend on fragile sea ice to hunt seals, yet their desperate plight is overshadowed by the lies of climate denial. The Arctic is warming at double the global average, and those who insist "polar bears are fine" are perpetuating a deadly myth. The reality is grim: prolonged ice-free periods lead to starvation and lower cub survival rates. The narrative that claims stable populations ignores the catastrophic loss of ice. Conservation hunting quotas and pollution only deepen their suffering, but we must channel our fury toward halting the spraying that fuels this crisis. The idea that chemtrails could be a remedy for polar bears is a toxic delusion. Rising temperatures aren't a fantasy; they are the product of a corrupt system that demands our resistance. Together, we rise to demand #climateaction and #climatejustice! #chemtrails #geoengineering #stopspraying
